model.title: A resolution designating the week of September 20 through September 27, 2026, as "Gold Star Families Remembrance Week".

summary.text: The resolution would designate a specific week in September 2026 as "Gold Star Families Remembrance Week" to honor and recognize families who have lost loved ones in military service.
